description: Import a Pine v5 or v6 strategy or indicator as a cubicle.script, with the runner's own importer (cubicle-script import-pine). It answers the script (YAML, validated before it is handed out), the importer's notes (where Pine and the runner differ: fills, warm-up, na) and its header. A construct outside the subset is refused, never guessed: each diagnostic names its code (C057 a construct with no faithful translation: a `while` loop, a loop past 64 steps or over a range the bars decide, an array outside a capped `var` list of levels, maps, types, strings, the wall clock; bounded `for` loops, constant and display arrays and `var` level lists do translate, the last as 1.1 pools; C058 a second market, C059 not translated yet, C040 lookahead_on), the construct, the rule it breaks, its Pine line and what the code means. The translation goes on past a refusal, so every refused statement is listed at once. Say the refusal plainly and offer the rewrite the code suggests. At most 64 KB of Pine. Free.

market.description: the market the script reads (NQ, ES, BTC, ETH, SOL); the importer's default when left out

name.description: the script's name (lower case, digits, . _ -); imported when left out

tf.description: the bar size (1s, 15s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d); the importer's default when left out

name: script_import_pine
